heading-1-0.content:
Being a
full-stack
developer
means I never
have the same
day twice.

text-2-0.content:
Monday  →  Designing a UI

Tuesday  →  Debugging an API

Wednesday  →  Writing DB queries

Thursday  →  Optimizing page speed

Friday  →  Shipping the feature

text-3-0.content: Every new feature teaches you something you didn't know yesterday.

text-3-1.content: You see the entire picture — not just your corner of it.

text-3-2.content: You ship faster because you're not waiting on anyone.

text-3-3.content: You break things faster too — but you also fix them faster.

text-4-0.content: Every feature — from the carousel builder to the AI engine to the scheduling system — went through one brain.

text-5-2.content: The best developers aren't the ones who know one thing deeply.

heading-5-2.content: They connect dots across the entire stack.
